name: Ash
epithet: The grey hound from the House kennels
appearance: A grey wolfhound bitch, long-boned, all rib and shoulder, with yellow eyes and a splinted hind leg, the hair worn off around it. Her lip comes up off her teeth with no sound at all before she bites.
last_seen_doing: Put her nose out from under the cot at the sound of the bones and took it back in; took the knucklebone that went off the blanket's edge and lay chewing it under the cot.
now: Under the Captain's cot on her nest of blanket with Hollis's fifth knucklebone, chewing it with great care.

known_facts.fact: She takes meat only from the Captain's left hand, with his right out of her sight.
known_facts.evidence: She would take from the Captain's left, and only with the right out of her sight

known_facts.fact: She growls at the grate in the kennel run, which the kennel-master says drains to the old cellars.
known_facts.evidence: "Drain," said the kennel-master. "Runs to the old cellars. She does that."

known_facts.fact: Maelis judged her a wolfhound that somebody once fed well, whose leg will take her weight by the thaw if she does not run on it.
known_facts.evidence: That's a wolfhound. Somebody fed her well, once.

known_facts.fact: She came off the bars to the name Ash and lay down with her splint across the Captain's boot.
known_facts.evidence: lay down against him with the new splint across his boot

known_facts.fact: She took the fifth knucklebone when it went off the blanket and kept it under the Captain's cot.
known_facts.evidence: There was a small, satisfied sound from under the cot, and then the sound of something being chewed with great care.

relationships.label: sleeps with her leg across his boot
relationships.note: She bit him through the thumb in the kennel run, then lay down with her splinted leg across his boot and slept.
